Yes, the 30-day evaluation cycle is stricter than what Part 2.2 requires.

The standard's governing requirement for Part 2.2 states that entities must, "At least once every 35 calendar days, evaluate security patches for applicability that have been released since the last evaluation from the source or sources identified in Part 2.1" [R14].

The operator's 30-day cycle is a deliberate "intentional_strictness" because "We evaluate patches every 30 days, not the 35 the Part allows, because our change window is monthly and a 35-day clock straddles two windows" [N1].
